explanation: It is active only at D1 right after an unrewarded trial where the agent chose a1, and is 0 at every GO and D2 step, after rewarded trials, and whenever the agent has been choosing a2. Its size depends on time in the episode: about 10 late (around trial 77 onward, mainly when the trial before the loss was rewarded, falling to about 6 then 4 or 0 on a second loss in a row), about 4-6 early (trials 0-50), and about 0 in the middle (trials 50-75).
